summaryZh: 知觉与认知实验室研究行为目标如何影响知觉、决策和记忆。它在人类参与者中结合心理物理学、计算建模以及fMRI和EEG神经成像方法。
researchQuestions: 行为目标如何影响知觉、决策和记忆？

evidence.quote: Our research focuses on understanding how behavioral goals influence perception, decision making, and memory. To investigate these questions, we combine psychophysics, computational modeling, and neuroimaging methods (fMRI and EEG) in human participants.
Welcome to the Perception and Cognition Lab at the University of California, San Diego.
